paragraphs: Access our top-rated, in-network, mental health treatment programs in a safe & secure online platform throughout California.
Our thoughtfully designed, in-network mental health programs are delivered affordably online across California.

Our Virtual IOP offers flexible, remote mental health care ideal for working adults, students, or those needing accessible support. Treatment typically includes virtual therapy for 3 hours a day, 3 days a week, over 8 to 12 weeks—providing structure and healing without disrupting daily life.

Our LGBTQIA+ Virtual Intensive Outpatient Program provides structured, affirming mental health care for individuals navigating mental health challenges in a safe, inclusive, and identity-affirming environment.
Our Evening Virtual IOP provides structured, evidence-based mental health care for adults who need consistent support while maintaining work, school, or daytime responsibilities.
Find out how our online therapy services can help from the comfort of your own home.
Our virtual IOP program delivers structured mental health support for stress and burnout, while also helping you navigate paid stress leave eligibility and administrative requirements.

With a wide range of degrees and experience, our team of psychiatrists, therapists, experiential practitioners, and mental health specialists — many of whom went through our programs themselves — are here to help you and your loved ones achieve sustainable wellbeing.
We provide mental health services for teens and adults, as well as substance use disorder treatment for adults across Los Angeles and California. Learn more about some of our featured services:

No matter your mental health challenges, we’re here to help. Our expert team of psychiatrists and mental health practitioners conducts thorough clinical assessments to diagnose and treat a range of mental health conditions, including depressive disorders, anxiety disorders, mood disorders, and more.

Our alcohol and drug detox and rehab programs feature a dedicated team of addiction specialists, drug and alcohol counselors, and board-certified psychiatrists providing comprehensive evaluations to diagnose and treat your addiction.

itemOffered.name: Residential Mental Health
itemOffered.description: Our residential program provides 24/7 immersive care for individuals with severe or persistent mental health needs. With an average stay of 30 days, clients receive intensive psychiatric support, a safe and supportive environment, and structured daily programming to promote stability and healing.

itemOffered.name: Virtual Intensive Outpatient Program (Virtual IOP)
itemOffered.description: Our Virtual IOP offers flexible, remote mental health care ideal for working adults, students, or those needing accessible support. Treatment typically includes virtual therapy for 3 hours a day, 3 days a week, over 8 to 12 weeks—providing structure and healing without disrupting daily life.

itemOffered.name: Residential Detox Program
itemOffered.description: Our medically supervised detox program provides 24/7 care in a safe, supportive environment for people withdrawing from drugs or alcohol. With continuous monitoring and evidence-based safety protocols, we help manage withdrawal symptoms and prepare clients for the next step in recovery.

itemOffered.name: Residential Rehab Program
itemOffered.description: Our residential rehab program offers full-time, structured care for individuals recovering from substance use, either following detox or as a primary treatment. With an average stay of 30+ days, clients receive daily therapy, medical support, relapse prevention planning, and holistic services in a supportive environment.

itemOffered.name: Dual Diagnosis Program
itemOffered.description: Our Dual Diagnosis Program is designed for individuals navigating both mental health and substance use disorders. Through integrated, whole-person care that combines clinical therapy and psychiatric support, we help clients address the root causes of both conditions and build a path to lasting recovery.

itemOffered.name: Outpatient Rehab
itemOffered.description: Our Outpatient Rehab offers flexible addiction treatment for individuals who don’t require 24/7 residential care. With options such as Intensive Outpatient (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization (PHP), this level of support is ideal for those transitioning from inpatient care or managing recovery alongside daily responsibilities.
